summary: Completed comprehensive testing of image and video upload functionality. Backend APIs 100% working (12/12 tests passed). Frontend upload UI working with drag-drop zone, progress indicator, and preview thumbnails. Property detail page gallery with prev/next navigation and thumbnails working correctly. Video player displaying uploaded videos.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/upload accepts PNG images (returns url, file_type, filename, size)
Backend: POST /api/upload accepts JPEG images
Backend: POST /api/upload accepts MP4 videos (file_type='video')
Backend: POST /api/upload accepts WebM videos
Backend: POST /api/upload rejects text files with 400 error
Backend: POST /api/upload rejects PDF files with 400 error
Backend: POST /api/upload requires authentication (403 without token)
Backend: GET /api/uploads/{filename} returns uploaded file (200)
Backend: POST /api/upload/multiple accepts multiple files at once
Backend: DELETE /api/upload/{filename} removes the file
Backend: POST /api/properties saves image URLs in images array
Backend: POST /api/properties saves video URLs in videos array
Frontend: Dashboard Add Property form has 'Photos & Videos' upload section
Frontend: Upload section has drag-and-drop zone with instructions
Frontend: File type hint shows 'JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, WebM - Max 50MB each'
Frontend: Uploading files shows progress indicator
Frontend: Uploaded files show preview thumbnails with filename
Frontend: Toast notification shows '1 file(s) uploaded' on success
Frontend: Property detail page shows image gallery with main image
Frontend: Gallery shows prev/next arrows when multiple images
Frontend: Gallery shows thumbnail strip under main image
Frontend: Gallery shows image counter (e.g., '2/3')
Frontend: Clicking thumbnails changes main image
Frontend: Clicking prev/next arrows navigates gallery
Frontend: Property detail page shows video player for uploaded videos
Frontend: Video player has controls (play, mute, fullscreen)
Frontend: Dashboard property cards show uploaded images as thumbnails
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Property with Images, TEST_Property with Videos, TEST_Gallery Property (3 images) for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Upload functionality fully working. Backend endpoints: POST /api/upload (single), POST /api/upload/multiple, DELETE /api/upload/{filename}, GET /api/uploads/{filename}. Files stored in /app/backend/uploads/. Frontend has drag-drop upload in Add Property modal. PropertyDetail.js has image gallery with currentImageIndex state for navigation. Videos displayed with HTML5 video player. All data-testid attributes in place for testing.
